text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.

- The national Court of Accounts said the former Social Democrat government allowed General Workers Union (UGT) access to European Uniin social funds even after being informed of irregularities in the union.
- The government says suspension of privatisation of chemical products company Qumigal is in interests of all.

- The Portuguese economy evolve positively in first quarter 1997 and the investment, particularly in the construction sector, was the main cause, according to the Bank of Portugal and the National Statistics Institute.
- Retail group Jeronimo Martins JPMR.IN is buying franchised areas in Portugal from French retail group Intermarche, which is losing market share.

- The European Comission said the Portuguese budget deficit was 4.1 pct of GDP in 1996, a figure slightly above that of the Portuguese government, due to differences in accounting methods between the Portuguese authorities and European statistics institute Eurostat.
